name: Tire Rotation
summary: Rotation pattern depends entirely on the car's tire package: square setups (205/55R16 or 225/45R17 all around) can be cross-rotated; Sport-package staggered 225/45R17 front and 255/40R17 rear can only be swapped side to side if tires are non-directional. Wheel bolt torque 120 Nm is supported only by secondary sources. TPMS reset steps are verified; whether a given car has direct TPMS (RDC) or indirect FTM must be checked on the car. No BMW-published rotation interval found.
variantDependencies: Engine (N52B30 vs N51B30 SULEV) UNCONFIRMED: no evidence found that the brake/tire/wiper jobs differ by engine; not a tracked dependency but unverified.
RWD vs xDrive UNCONFIRMED: front wear sensor part number differs (34356789441 listed for xi/xDrive vs 34356789440 for non-xi); front jack point differs on xDrive.
Production date UNCONFIRMED: retailer fitment splits at 03/2010 (wear sensors) and 09/2009 (wipers); a 2010 model year car may fall on either side.
Brake package UNCONFIRMED: retailers split fitment between 'standard' and 'M Performance' front brakes (larger front brake); front pad part number depends on it.
Transmission (manual vs auto) UNCONFIRMED: no evidence it affects these jobs.
Tire package: square (16 in 205/55R16 or 17 in 225/45R17) vs Sport-package staggered 17 in (225/45R17 front, 255/40R17 rear) per two retailer tables.
Directional or asymmetric tires: forum posts disagree on whether stock RE050A is directional; read sidewall.
TPMS: 2009-13 E90 may have direct TPM or indirect FTM; menu and reset differ.
RWD vs xDrive: one blog suggests longer rotation interval on xDrive (about 7,000 mi) vs 5,000 mi; only a single blog source and not BMW.
Spare: compact spare/chains installed must not be present during TPMS reset.

tools.item: 17 mm socket (1/2 in drive) for wheel bolts
Locking-bolt key if car has locking bolts (from BMW wheel-lock set)
Tire pressure gauge and inflator (TPMS reset requires correct pressure)

parts.item: Wheel bolts M12x1.5, 17 mm hex, 60-degree tapered seat (replacement only)

torque.conflicts: All secondary; one source suggests confirming. No BMW document located. BimmerWorld's 75 ft-lb (about 102 Nm) is for its aftermarket nuts, not OE bolts. Staggered/square tire table sources: sizemytires (xDrive 2010) and Mavis (2010 328i Sport package).

steps.title: Identify tire package
steps.instruction: Read both front and rear tire sidewalls. Same size all four: square. Wider rear (255/40R17 vs 225/45R17): staggered. Note any directional arrow and the inside/outside labels.
warnings: Never rotate front to rear on staggered setups.

steps.title: Pick pattern
steps.instruction: Square non-directional: cross-rotation or front/rear swap; square directional: swap front and rear same side; staggered non-directional: swap sides only, which needs the tires remounted on wheels (forum estimate about $50 per axle); staggered directional: no rotation without remounting.
warnings: Forum sources disagree on RE050A direction; read sidewall. No BMW rotation chart located.

steps.title: Loosen bolts and raise car
steps.instruction: Loosen wheel bolts a turn on the ground, jack at the jack points (rear: cast-iron differential housing), set stands.
warnings: Stands, not the jack, hold the car.
xDrive front jack point differs from RWD.

steps.title: Move wheels
steps.instruction: Remove wheels and refit per pattern; clean the hub face of rust first.
warnings: Hub-centric fit; keep mounting face clean (general practice, unsourced).

steps.title: Torque in star pattern
steps.instruction: Lower the car and torque all bolts to 120 Nm in a crisscross order.
warnings: Torque from secondary sources; re-check after first drive (general practice).

steps.title: Set pressures
steps.instruction: Set all four tires to the placard pressure.

steps.title: Reset tire monitor
steps.instruction: Direct TPM with iDrive: Vehicle Info > Vehicle Status > RESET TPM after inflating, engine on, then drive a few minutes. FTM (indirect) uses the same Vehicle Status reset. Without iDrive: scroll turn-signal stalk to TPMS RESET and hold the button about 5 s, then drive about 15 min.
warnings: Do not reset with compact spare or snow chains fitted.
Whether sensor positions auto-relearn after rotation: MISSING.

safety: Never exceed or skip wheel bolt torque; do not torque hot bolts.
Do not rotate staggered tires front-to-rear.
Do not reset TPMS with a spare or chains on.
missingEvidence: BMW-published rotation interval or pattern guidance for E90.
BMW document for wheel bolt torque (only secondary).
TPMS: whether sensors auto-learn position after rotation.
Wheel-bolt thread/hex for this exact car (one source mentions some later models use M14x1.25).
Whether stock Sport-package tire is directional.
ownerInputsNeeded: Tire sizes front and rear, and any directional arrows.
